fusions.name: Offshoot Thorn
fusions.desc: Throws a thorn that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, then branches to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each taking 60% of the damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Ramifying Briar
fusions.desc: Grows a branching briar across a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 12 damage and leaving every enemy hit [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to enemies within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Divided Sap
fusions.desc: Splits your sap between you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, restoring 14 health to each, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Sideshoot
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a thorn branches off toward the nearest enemy within 8 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
